name: Galápagos Conservancy Conservation Action Grants
summary: Annual competitive grants (Small Grants for conservation actions and WISE for women in sustainable enterprises) for conservation and sustainability work in the Galápagos province, open to permanent residents.

amount.note: Average US$5,000, up to US$10,000 in exceptional cases

eligibility.rule: Is a permanent resident of the Insular Region
Individual applicants: no activities that public institutions are responsible for

Galápagos Conservancy no financiará proyectos a personas naturales, para desarrollar actividades que son competencia de Instituciones Públicas, ejemplo: arreglo de veredas, arreglo de parques, arreglo de vías, recolección de residuos, murales en vías públicas, en entre otros.
